items.title: Google is illegally monopolizing online advertising tech, judge rules
items.title_zh: 法官裁定 Google 非法垄断在线广告技术
items.summary: A judge ruled that Google is illegally monopolizing online advertising technology, according to the report.

items.title: Why is OpenAI buying Windsurf?
items.raw_content: $3 billion seems high to me. Google is on a warpath. And Apple shoots itself in the foot, twice.
items.title_zh: OpenAI 为何要收购 Windsurf？
items.summary: A commentary piece questions whether OpenAI's $3 billion purchase of Windsurf is worth the price, while also discussing Google's competitive push and Apple's missteps.

items.title: NVIDIA CEO visits Beijing as new US restrictions may halt H20 chips exports to China
items.raw_content: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang made his second visit to Beijing this year on Thursday, just three months after his previous trip to China. During his visit, Huang reaffirmed the company’s long-term commitment to the Chinese market, stressing that despite challenges posed by US government export controls on chips, NVIDIA will continue to adapt its product lineup to meet regulatory requirements and remain deeply invested in China.
items.title_zh: 英伟达 CEO 访问北京，美国新限制或使 H20 芯片对华出口受阻
items.summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang made his second visit to Beijing this year, reaffirming the company's long-term commitment to China and saying it will keep adapting its product lineup to US export rules.

items.title: GPT-4.1 in the API
items.title_zh: GPT-4.1 登陆 API
items.summary: OpenAI's release page announces GPT-4.1 as available in the API, according to the company's own announcement.

items.title: Alibaba-backed Zhipu AI preps IPO, first among China’s top six AI unicorns
items.raw_content: Zhipu AI, one of China’s leading foundational model startups, has kicked off preparations for an IPO, making it the first of China’s six AI unicorns to
items.title_zh: 阿里投资的智谱 AI 启动 IPO 筹备，为中国六大 AI 独角兽中首家
items.summary: Zhipu AI, an Alibaba-backed foundation model startup, has kicked off preparations for an IPO, making it the first of China's six AI unicorns to do so.

items.title: Google is illegally monopolizing online advertising tech, judge rules
items.title_zh: 法官裁定 Google 非法垄断在线广告技术
items.summary: A judge ruled that Google is illegally monopolizing online advertising technology, according to the report.

items.title: Why is OpenAI buying Windsurf?
items.title_zh: OpenAI 为何要收购 Windsurf？
items.summary: A commentary piece questions whether OpenAI's $3 billion purchase of Windsurf is worth the price, while also discussing Google's competitive push and Apple's missteps.

items.title: GPT-4.1 in the API
items.title_zh: GPT-4.1 登陆 API
items.summary: OpenAI's release page announces GPT-4.1 as available in the API, according to the company's own announcement.

items.title: A hackable AI assistant using a single SQLite table and a handful of cron jobs
items.title_zh: 用一张 SQLite 表和几个 cron 任务搭建可改造的 AI 助手
items.summary: Geoffrey Litt describes building a useful AI assistant for his family from a single SQLite table of memories plus a handful of cron jobs that ingest memories and send updates, all hosted on Val.town. He argues that handy personal LLM tools do not require elaborate agent, memory or RAG frameworks.

items.title: New Vulnerability in GitHub Copilot, Cursor: Hackers Can Weaponize Code Agents
items.title_zh: GitHub Copilot 与 Cursor 曝新漏洞：黑客可武器化代码智能体
items.summary: A Pillar Security blog post describes a new vulnerability in GitHub Copilot and Cursor that, according to the headline, could let hackers weaponize code agents; the page also promotes the firm's SAIL 2.0 framework for securing AI agents.

items.title: Generate videos in Gemini and Whisk with Veo 2
items.title_zh: 在 Gemini 和 Whisk 中使用 Veo 2 生成视频
items.summary: A Google blog post says users can now generate videos in Gemini, powered by the company's Veo 2 model.

items.title: TLS certificate lifetimes will officially reduce to 47 days
items.title_zh: TLS 证书有效期将正式缩短至 47 天
items.summary: The CA/Browser Forum has voted to amend the TLS Baseline Requirements to set a schedule for shortening the lifetime of TLS certificates.

items.title: Dirty tricks 6502 programmers use (2019)
items.title_zh: 6502 程序员使用的「脏」技巧（2019）
items.summary: The post recaps Commodore 64 coding tricks from a small competition whose entries had to draw a given two-line image in as few bytes as possible.

items.title: Snapchat is harming children at an industrial scale?
items.title_zh: Snapchat 正在大规模伤害儿童？
items.summary: An essay argues, citing Snap Inc.'s own words, that the company's design choices expose millions of children to harm.

items.title: This 'College Protester' Isn't Real. It's an AI-Powered Undercover Bot for Cops
items.title_zh: 这名“大学抗议者”不是真人，而是警方使用的 AI 卧底机器人
items.summary: According to Wired, Massive Blue is helping police deploy AI-powered social media bots that converse with people suspected of offenses ranging from violent sex crimes to vaguely defined protest activity.

items.title: Deafening Silence from the Cybersecurity Industry
items.title_zh: 网络安全行业震耳欲聋的沉默
items.summary: A Forbes commentary examines what it calls the cybersecurity industry's deafening silence, though the available excerpt does not identify the specific issue.

items.title: UML diagram for the DDD example in Evans' book
items.title_zh: Evans 书中 DDD 示例的 UML 图
items.summary: A GitHub project uses UML diagrams to illustrate the structure and behavior of the cargo-shipping example from Eric Evans' Domain-Driven Design book.

items.title: Inside ArXiv
items.title_zh: 走进 arXiv
items.summary: A Wired feature examines arXiv three decades after it began and profiles its creator, who still cannot let the repository go.

items.title: Synology Lost the Plot with Hard Drive Locking Move
items.title_zh: Synology 的硬盘锁定举措跑偏了
items.summary: According to reports cited by ServeTheHome, Synology intends to restrict some features on its new 2025 Plus models to its own branded hard drives.

items.title: Layered Design in Go
items.title_zh: Go 语言中的分层设计
items.summary: The post describes a layered approach to designing Go programs and highlights Go's rule that packages may not reference each other circularly.

items.title: Adipose tissue retains an epigenetic memory of obesity after weight loss
items.title_zh: 减重后脂肪组织仍保留肥胖的表观遗传记忆
items.summary: A Nature paper reports stable epigenetic changes in mouse adipocytes that indicate an obesogenic memory, priming cells for pathological responses in an obesogenic environment and potentially contributing to the yo-yo effect often seen with dieting.

items.title: Understanding the Origins and the Evolution of Vi and Vim
items.title_zh: 探寻 Vi 与 Vim 的起源与演变
items.summary: The article traces the history of the Vi and Vim text editors, framing their evolution within the broader history of open-source software.

items.title: How to Write a Fast Matrix Multiplication from Scratch with Tensor Cores (2024)
items.title_zh: 如何用 Tensor Core 从零编写快速矩阵乘法（2024）
items.summary: A developer blog post describes writing an optimized half-precision matrix multiplication kernel in CUDA with tensor cores on an NVIDIA Tesla T4, using the HGEMM operation as its target.

items.title: NVIDIA CEO visits Beijing as new US restrictions may halt H20 chips exports to China
items.title_zh: 英伟达 CEO 访问北京，美国新限制或使 H20 芯片对华出口受阻
items.summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang made his second visit to Beijing this year, reaffirming the company's long-term commitment to China and saying it will keep adapting its product lineup to US export rules.

items.title: Alibaba-backed Zhipu AI preps IPO, first among China’s top six AI unicorns
items.title_zh: 阿里投资的智谱 AI 启动 IPO 筹备，为中国六大 AI 独角兽中首家
items.summary: Zhipu AI, an Alibaba-backed foundation model startup, has kicked off preparations for an IPO, making it the first of China's six AI unicorns to do so.

items.title: China and EU resume negotiations on EV duties following Trump tariff hikes
items.title_zh: 特朗普加征关税后，中欧重启电动汽车关税谈判
items.summary: China and the European Union have restarted negotiations to set a price floor on Chinese-made EV imports in place of duties of up to 45.3%, according to TechNode.

items.title: Tesla suspends sales of imported vehicles in China due to tariffs
items.title_zh: 受关税影响，特斯拉暂停在华销售进口车型
items.summary: Tesla has de-facto suspended sales and marketing of its imported Model S and Model X in China, which have faced retaliatory 125% import tariffs, TechNode reports.

items.title: China’s Xpeng to use own autonomous driving chip on par with Nvidia Thor: reports
items.title_zh: 小鹏将启用自研自动驾驶芯片，据称比肩英伟达 Thor
items.summary: Chinese electric vehicle maker Xpeng Motors will start using its own chips for advanced driving functions in an upcoming car model in the current quarter, according to reports.

items.title: Xiaomi may delay launch of first SUV, source says
items.title_zh: 消息称小米首款 SUV 发布或推迟
items.summary: Xiaomi plans to postpone the launch of its first electric crossover, the YU7, by about a month to August instead of June or July, according to a source cited by Chinese media.

items.title: BEYOND Expo 2025 AI Summit: Everything you should know about AI in Asia
items.title_zh: BEYOND Expo 2025 AI 峰会：关于亚洲 AI 你需要知道的一切
items.summary: A preview of the BEYOND Expo 2025 AI Summit, framed around Asia and especially China becoming the center of the global AI revolution.

items.title: NVIDIA hit with $5.5 billion blow as US tightens chip export rules to China
items.title_zh: 美国收紧对华芯片出口限制，NVIDIA 面临 55 亿美元损失
items.summary: NVIDIA shares fell nearly 7% on Wednesday after the company disclosed it would face $5.5 billion in costs stemming from tighter US chip export rules targeting China.

items.title: Chinese milk tea chain Chagee hits $6.2 billion valuation on Nasdaq debut
items.title_zh: 中国奶茶连锁品牌霸王茶姬纳斯达克上市，估值达 62 亿美元
items.summary: According to Reuters, Chagee shares rose 21% on their Nasdaq debut, closing at $33.75 and lifting the Chinese tea chain's valuation to $6.2 billion.

items.title: Tencent unveils largest ever hiring drive, adding 28,000 internships to bolster AI talent
items.title_zh: 腾讯启动史上最大招聘计划，新增 28,000 个实习岗位以充实 AI 人才
items.summary: Tencent announced its largest-ever hiring initiative, saying it plans to add 28,000 internship positions as part of efforts to strengthen its AI talent pipeline.

items.title: KaringX/clashmi
items.title_zh: clashmi：跨平台的 Clash Mihomo 客户端
items.summary: ClashMi packages Clash Mihomo for iOS, macOS, Android, Windows and Linux; the project is written in Dart.

items.title: AmoyLab/Unla
items.title_zh: AmoyLab/Unla：无需改代码的 MCP 网关
items.summary: Unla is a lightweight MCP gateway that turns existing MCP servers and APIs into MCP servers without code changes, with Docker deployment and a management UI.

items.title: Hamed233/Cybersecurity-Mastery-Roadmap
items.title_zh: Hamed233/Cybersecurity-Mastery-Roadmap
items.summary: A repository offering a step-by-step guide to mastering cybersecurity from beginner to expert, with curated resources, tools and career guidance.

items.title: Darkatse/TauriTavern
items.title_zh: Darkatse/TauriTavern：用 Tauri/Rust 重写的经典 SillyTavern
items.summary: TauriTavern is a rewrite of the classic SillyTavern project using Tauri and Rust, with the repository listed as JavaScript.

items.title: MajoSissi/animeko-source
items.title_zh: MajoSissi/animeko-source
items.summary: Animeko-source provides aggregated subscription and data sources for the Animeko app, written in JavaScript.

items.title: alvinunreal/tmuxai
items.title_zh: alvinunreal/tmuxai：AI 驱动的非侵入式终端助手
items.summary: tmuxai is an AI-powered terminal assistant written in Go that is designed to be non-intrusive while working in the terminal.

items.title: snarktank/ai-dev-tasks
items.title_zh: snarktank/ai-dev-tasks：管理 AI 开发代理的简易任务系统
items.summary: A lightweight task-management system for organizing work performed by AI development agents.

items.title: ziqihuangg/Awesome-From-Video-Generation-to-World-Model
items.title_zh: 从视频生成到世界模型：Awesome 资源集
items.summary: A curated list of works on video generation and its path toward world models.

items.title: kushalpandya/Petrichor
items.title_zh: Petrichor：离线 macOS 音乐播放器
items.summary: Petrichor is an offline music player for macOS written in Swift.

items.title: BrowseComp: A Simple Yet Challenging Benchmark for Browsing Agents
items.title_zh: BrowseComp：一个简单却颇具挑战的浏览智能体基准
items.summary: OpenAI authors present BrowseComp, a benchmark of 1,266 questions that require browsing agents to navigate the web persistently for hard-to-find, entangled information, with short answers that are easy to verify.

items.title: Is Trust Correlated With Explainability in AI? A Meta-Analysis
items.title_zh: AI 的可解释性与信任相关吗？一项元分析
items.summary: A meta-analysis drawing on 90 studies finds a statistically significant but moderate positive correlation between AI explainability and user trust, indicating explainability is not the sole or predominant factor.

items.title: CleanMAP: Distilling Multimodal LLMs for Confidence-Driven Crowdsourced HD Map Updates
items.title_zh: CleanMAP：蒸馏多模态大模型，为众包高精地图更新提供置信度
items.summary: CleanMAP is a distillation framework built on multimodal LLMs that scores lane visibility in crowdsourced data and fuses the highest-confidence local maps. On a real autonomous-vehicle dataset, fusing the top three maps cut mean update error to 0.28 m from a 0.37 m baseline.

items.title: Real-time Object and Event Detection Service through Computer Vision and Edge Computing
items.title_zh: 基于计算机视觉与边缘计算的实时目标与事件检测服务
items.summary: Researchers propose a road-monitoring and safety system for smart cities that combines computer vision with edge computing and was evaluated on the Aveiro Tech City Living Lab, detecting vehicles, pedestrians and bicycles and predicting collision events.

items.title: In between myth and reality: AI for math -- a case study in category theory
items.title_zh: 神话与现实之间：AI 用于数学的范畴论案例研究
items.summary: The author reports on an experiment using two prominent contemporary AI systems for mathematical research in category theory, aiming to understand how AI can assist research and to offer suggestions for system developers.

items.title: Exploring Pseudo-Token Approaches in Transformer Neural Processes
items.title_zh: 探索 Transformer 神经过程中的伪 token 方法
items.summary: The paper studies pseudo-token methods for Transformer Neural Processes and introduces Induced Set Attentive Neural Processes, which aim to balance predictive performance against computational cost on tasks such as regression, image completion and Bayesian optimization.

items.title: SuperCL: Superpixel Guided Contrastive Learning for Medical Image Segmentation Pre-training
items.title_zh: SuperCL：用于医学图像分割预训练的超像素引导对比学习
items.summary: The paper proposes SuperCL, a superpixel-guided contrastive learning method for medical image segmentation pre-training, reporting gains over 12 existing methods across 8 datasets.

items.title: The Impact of AI on the Cyber Offense-Defense Balance and the Character of Cyber Conflict
items.title_zh: AI 对网络攻防平衡及网络冲突性质的影响
items.summary: The author reviews the literature and collects nine arguments for offensive advantage and nine for defensive advantage in cyber conflict, plus additional propositions on the character of cyber competition. The paper concludes that the cyber domain is too multifaceted for a single answer and presents 44 ways AI is expected to affect the offense-defense balance.
